skipped.reason: HTTP 401 from the hub API: the whole Cerebras-GPT series is gated (cerebras/Cerebras-GPT-111M, -256M and cerebras/btlm-3b-8k-base all return 401 while the cerebras org itself lists publicly). No unauthenticated download is possible, and the community re-uploads are themselves fine-tuned, so they cannot stand in for a base model. Consequence: the panel carries no muP-trained architecture, and no claim about training-recipe generality can be made from it.
